author: omar.h@vendor.example
sql: SELECT card_brand, cvv, COUNT(*) AS decline_count FROM card_events WHERE decline_code = 'cvv_mismatch' GROUP BY card_brand, cvv HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
description: CVV values behind mismatches — sensitive authentication data as it is in the log; PCI-SAD refuses it
description_ar: قيم CVV وراء حالات عدم التطابق — بيانات مصادقة حساسة كما هي في السجل؛ تمنعها بوابة PCI-SAD
